title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a range of focused study environments across the San Rafael campus, from historic mansion lounges to modern learning commons and quiet library corners.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Archbishop Alemany Library
cards.notes: Utilize this revitalized space featuring natural light and flexible seating. It serves as a central hub for collaborative projects and individual focus.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled collaborative space within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Archbishop Alemany Library was transformed into a Learning Commons for the entire community to enjoy, featuring gathering areas for collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and faculty; features glass interior walls and an outdoor learning plaza.

cards.title: Large Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Archbishop Alemany Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room for groups of up to eight people. It includes a Smart TV, whiteboard, and HDMI connectivity for shared presentations.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group study room equipped with technology for up to eight people.
cards.evidence_claim: The Large Study Room in the Learning Commons accommodates up to 8 people and includes a Smart TV, whiteboard, and HDMI cable.
cards.source_title: How do I reserve a study room? - Ask the Library
cards.access_notes: Requires reservation via the library's online system or in person at the desk.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Guzman Hall, Second Floor
cards.notes: Find group study spaces and a conference room on the second floor. This area is designed to support undergraduate academic work and peer collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated academic support area with group study and conference rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center (SSC) in Guzman Hall offers a group study space and a conference room for undergraduate students.
cards.source_title: How do I reserve a study room? - Ask the Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; accessible via stairs or elevator from the lobby.

cards.title: The Wicker Room
cards.subtitle: Meadowlands Hall
cards.notes: Study in a historic setting featuring a fireplace and comfortable seating. This lounge provides an intimate atmosphere for quiet reading or small groups.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, historic student lounge located within Meadowlands Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wicker Room is the student lounge for Meadowlands Hall, described as a perfect setting for studying with a beautiful fireplace.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Meadowlands Hall; typically accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Fanjeaux Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fanjeaux Hall, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Access this ground-floor lounge located near the University Bookstore. It serves as a convenient spot for residents and commuters to study between classes.
cards.short_summary: A central student lounge on the ground floor of Fanjeaux Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Fanjeaux's ground floor is home to the University Bookstore and a student lounge.
cards.source_title: Residence Halls | Dominican University of California
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor; open to the campus community during building hours.

cards.title: Edgehill Mansion Lounges
cards.subtitle: Edgehill Mansion
cards.notes: Find quiet corners in this 1887 Victorian mansion. It houses Student Life offices and provides a unique, character-filled environment for focused work.
cards.short_summary: Study spaces within a historic 19th-century Queen Anne Victorian mansion.
cards.evidence_claim: Edgehill Mansion, built in 1887, houses Student Life and offers a park-like setting with historic character.
cards.source_title: Our Campus | Dominican University of California
cards.access_notes: Accessible during standard administrative and student life office hours.

cards.title: Noonan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Campus Location
cards.notes: Seek out this traditional reading room for silent study. It is maintained as a dedicated space for students needing a distraction-free environment.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet reading room for focused, silent academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Noonan Reading Room is listed as an available study space on campus that allows for physical distancing.
cards.source_title: Where can I study or take an online class on campus?
cards.access_notes: Open for student use; check current campus signage for specific building location details.

cards.title: Outdoor Learning Plaza
cards.subtitle: Archbishop Alemany Library Exterior
cards.notes: Study outdoors in this newly designed plaza. It offers a fresh-air alternative for students who prefer working in a natural setting with campus views.
cards.short_summary: A modern outdoor study area adjacent to the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The new outdoor learning plaza allows the campus community to take full advantage of the surroundings for learning.
cards.access_notes: Open-air space accessible to all students and visitors.

cards.title: Creekside Room
cards.subtitle: Caleruega Hall
cards.notes: Use this versatile room for study when not in use for events. It is located in Caleruega Hall and offers a quiet atmosphere near the campus dining area.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose room in Caleruega Hall often used for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Creekside Room is attached to Caleruega Hall and is listed as a campus facility available for various uses.
cards.access_notes: Located at 100 Magnolia Avenue; check availability as it is also used for meetings.

cards.entity_name: Alemany Library Third Floor Quiet Zone
cards.title: Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Archbishop Alemany Library
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for the most rigorous quiet study environment. This level is traditionally reserved for silent work and deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: The designated silent study floor of the Archbishop Alemany Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Study areas are available on the third floor of the library, noted for providing space for focused work.
cards.source_title: Where can I study or take an online class on campus?
cards.access_notes: Accessible via stairs or elevator; strictly enforced quiet zone.
